meaning: what the learner predicted; read by the developmental observer only

comparison_records.persist_pe_body: [rows, bodies, senses] per model step k, body and sense: mean over the token's numbers of (older token - newer token) squared, the older token as the transformer received it (re-encoded with the command in force); NaN where the sense was not graded
comparison_records.vision_no_copy_body: [rows, bodies] per model step k and body: vision's prediction error of the same transition with the gaze copy's term left out; equal to next_pe_body's vision column where the copy added nothing (gaze_copy_applied false)
comparison_records.gaze_copy_applied: 1 the gaze copy added its term, 0 it added nothing, -1 not read
